# Reading conventions — family-independent

- Contracts spell small numbers as words ("seven years", "four hours"). Capture the value.
- Percentages are stated to one or more decimals; preserve the stated precision.
- A rate is a value **plus a basis** ("$3,000 per tenth of a percentage point"). Losing the basis
  loses the obligation.
- Currency is whatever the document states. **Never assume one.**
- Party names are defined in the opening article; resolve roles from the document, never from the
  family.
